<!doctype html>
<html lang="id"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><style>body{margin:0}</style>
<title>Call Activity - The Winner</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: filter bar on top, KPI strip, two charts, coach + daily/weekly recap, agent table, long-call list */
:root{
  --bg:#f3f5f8; --surface:#ffffff; --ink:#131822; --ink2:#4a5365; --muted:#79849a; --line:#e2e6ed;
  --blue:#2a78d6; --blue-soft:#e6f0fc; --orange:#eb6834; --orange-soft:#fdece5; --neutral:#ccd3de; --serA:#8e9ab0; --amber:#a8690b; --good:#0f8a5f; --warn:#b4540a;
  --font:'Figtree',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; --mono:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:#0e1218; --surface:#161b24; --ink:#eceff4; --ink2:#b5bdcb; --muted:#8892a4; --line:#252c38;
  --blue:#3987e5; --blue-soft:#17283d; --orange:#d95926; --orange-soft:#33201a; --neutral:#38414f; --serA:#6c788e; --amber:#e3a93a; --good:#3fbf8f; --warn:#f0a060; color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0e1218; --surface:#161b24; --ink:#eceff4; --ink2:#b5bdcb; --muted:#8892a4; --line:#252c38;
  --blue:#3987e5; --blue-soft:#17283d; --orange:#d95926; --orange-soft:#33201a; --neutral:#38414f; --serA:#6c788e; --amber:#e3a93a; --good:#3fbf8f; --warn:#f0a060; color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a1a3f 0,#102a63 230px,var(--bg) 230px) no-repeat,var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font);font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;
  padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));padding-block:20px 40px}
.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
h1{font-size:22px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-wrap:balance}
h2{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 2px;font-weight:600}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
header{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 16px;align-items:flex-end}
.panel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:16px;min-width:0}
.filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 14px;align-items:flex-end}
.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.f label{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
select,input[type=search]{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;min-width:150px;max-width:100%}
select:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,th[data-k]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:12px}
.kpi{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}
.kpi .l{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.kpi .v{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:26px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.kpi .n{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2)}
.kpi.hi{background:var(--orange-soft);border-color:transparent}
.kpi.hi .v{color:var(--orange)}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,460px),1fr));gap:16px}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);margin:6px 0 4px}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:-1px}
svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
svg text{fill:var(--muted);font-family:var(--font);font-size:11px}
svg text.val{fill:var(--ink2);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px}
.tw{overflow-x:auto;margin-top:8px}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:13px}
th,td{padding:7px 10px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
th:first-child,td:first-child{text-align:left}
th{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--surface)}
th[data-k]{cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
th[data-k]:hover{color:var(--ink)}
th .ar{color:var(--blue)}
td.num{font-family:var(--mono)}
tr.tot td{font-weight:600;border-top:2px solid var(--line)}
.sm{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end}
.bar .t{width:90px;height:8px;background:transparent;display:flex;gap:2px}
.bar .t b{display:block;height:8px;border-radius:2px}
.pill{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--orange-soft);color:var(--orange)}
.pill.z{background:transparent;color:var(--muted)}
.tag{font-size:11px;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink2);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tag.warn{color:var(--warn);border-color:var(--warn);background:transparent}
.dist{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.dist .r{display:grid;grid-template-columns:92px 1fr 90px;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:13px}
.dist .tr{height:12px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.dist .tr b{display:block;height:12px;border-radius:3px}
.dist .c{font-family:var(--mono);text-align:right;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2)}
button.more{font:inherit;color:var(--blue);background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 14px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:10px}
button.more:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}
#tip{position:fixed;z-index:50;pointer-events:none;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);font-size:12px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:6px;max-width:240px;display:none;line-height:1.4}
footer{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.note{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);background:var(--blue-soft);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px}
.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.nav{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nav button{font:inherit;font-weight:600;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer}
.nav button.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.nav button:focus-visible,.chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.chip{font:inherit;font-size:12px;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer}
.cat{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:1px 9px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid currentColor;white-space:nowrap}
.cat.h{color:var(--good)}.cat.m{color:var(--amber)}.cat.l{color:var(--orange)}.cat.n{color:var(--muted)}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px;background:var(--muted)}
.dot.h{background:var(--good)}.dot.m{background:var(--amber)}.dot.l{background:var(--orange)}
.seg{display:flex;gap:2px;width:140px;height:10px}.seg b{display:block;height:10px;border-radius:2px;min-width:0}
.seg b.h{background:var(--good)}.seg b.m{background:var(--amber)}.seg b.l{background:var(--orange)}
.chip.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.dl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.dl.up{color:var(--good)}.dl.down{color:var(--warn)}.dl.flat{color:var(--muted)}
.kpi .n .dl{margin-left:4px}
td .sm .dl{margin-left:2px}
@media (max-width:560px){.kpi .v{font-size:22px}h1{font-size:19px}}
header h1{color:#fff}header>div>.sub,header #meta{color:#b9c8ea}
.nav button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#e3ebfb}
.nav button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.nav button.on{background:#fff;border-color:#fff;color:#0a1a3f}
.panel,.kpi{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(10,26,63,.08)}
.kpi{border-top:3px solid #1d4ba8}
th{color:#3b4f7d}
</style>

<div class="wrap">
  <header>
    <div>
      <h1>Call Activity Tim Deti Laharwati</h1>
      <div class="sub" id="meta"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="filters panel" style="padding:10px 12px">
      <div class="f" id="fPeriodWrap"><label for="fDate">Periode</label><select id="fDate"></select></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="fLayer">Layer</label><select id="fLayer"></select></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="fCoach">Coach</label><select id="fCoach"></select></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="fQ">Cari agent</label><input type="search" id="fQ" placeholder="Nama agent"></div>
    </div>
  </header>
  <nav class="nav" id="nav"><button id="tabDash" class="on" type="button">Call</button><button id="tabCmp" type="button">Call Review</button><button id="tabPerf" type="button">Performance</button><button id="tabPcmp" type="button">Performance Review</button><button id="tabProd" type="button">Productivity</button></nav>
  <div class="stack" id="viewDash">
  <div class="note" id="note" hidden></div>
  <section class="kpis" id="kpis"></section>

  <section class="grid2">
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Call per jam</h2>
      <div class="sub">Jumlah dial dan yang tersambung, jam WIB</div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--blue)"></i>Tersambung</span><span><i style="background:var(--neutral)"></i>Tidak tersambung</span></div>
      <div id="chHour"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Rentang call tersambung &gt; 5 menit</h2>
      <div class="sub">Jam mulai call yang bicara lebih dari 5 menit</div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--orange)"></i>Call &gt; 5 menit</span></div>
      <div id="chLong"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="grid2">
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Dial harian</h2>
      <div class="sub">Per tanggal, mengikuti filter layer, coach, dan agent</div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--blue)"></i>Tersambung</span><span><i style="background:var(--neutral)"></i>Tidak tersambung</span></div>
      <div id="chDay"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Kumulatif bulan Oktober</h2>
      <div class="sub">Akumulasi dari awal bulan sampai tiap tanggal</div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--blue)"></i>Dial</span><span><i style="background:var(--serA)"></i>Unique</span><span><i style="background:var(--orange)"></i>Tersambung</span></div>
      <div id="chCum"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="grid2">
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Sebaran durasi call tersambung</h2>
      <div class="sub" id="distSub"></div>
      <div class="dist" id="dist"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Per coach</h2>
      <div class="sub">Perbandingan antar kelompok coach</div>
      <div class="tw"><table id="tCoach"></table></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="grid2">
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Rekap harian</h2>
      <div class="sub">Mengikuti filter layer, coach, dan agent</div>
      <div class="tw"><table id="tDay"></table></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Rekap mingguan</h2>
      <div class="sub">Minggu ISO (Senin sampai Minggu), plus rata-rata per minggu</div>
      <div class="tw"><table id="tWeek"></table></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="panel">
    <h2>Rekap per agent</h2>
    <div class="filters" style="justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end"><div class="sub">Klik judul kolom untuk mengurutkan</div><div class="chips" id="colMode"><button type="button" class="chip" data-m="day">Kolom per hari</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-m="week">Kolom per minggu</button></div></div>
    <div class="tw"><table id="tAgent"></table></div>
  </section>

  <section class="panel">
    <h2>Daftar call &gt; 5 menit</h2>
    <div class="sub" id="longSub"></div>
    <div class="tw"><table id="tLong"></table></div>
    <button class="more" id="moreBtn" hidden>Tampilkan semua</button>
  </section>

  </div>

  <div class="stack" id="viewCmp" hidden>
    <section class="panel cmpctl">
      <div class="filters">
        <div class="f"><label>Jenis</label><div class="chips" id="cType"><button type="button" class="chip on" data-t="week">Week to week</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-t="day">Day to day</button></div></div>
        <div class="filters" id="wkCtl">
          <div class="f"><label for="cB">Minggu ini</label><select id="cB"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label for="cA">Dibanding minggu</label><select id="cA"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label for="cM">Basis</label><select id="cM"><option value="same">Hari yang sama</option><option value="total">Total minggu</option></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label>Pilihan cepat</label><div class="chips" id="cChips"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="filters" id="dyCtl" hidden>
          <div class="f"><label for="dB">Hari</label><select id="dB"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label for="dA">Dibanding hari</label><select id="dA"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label for="dM">Jam</label><select id="dM"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label>Pilihan cepat</label><div class="chips" id="dChips"><button type="button" class="chip" data-act="latest">Hari terbaru vs kemarin</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-act="yday">vs kemarin</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-act="lw">vs hari sama minggu lalu</button></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    <div class="sub" id="cNote"></div>
    <section class="kpis" id="cKpis"></section>
    <section class="grid2">
      <div class="panel"><h2 id="cT1">Dial per hari dalam minggu</h2><div class="sub" id="cS1">Sen sampai Min</div><div class="legend" id="cLg1"></div><div id="cDow"></div></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2>Dial per coach</h2><div class="sub">Pada basis yang dipilih</div><div class="legend" id="cLg2"></div><div id="cCoachBar"></div></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel">
      <h2>Perubahan per coach</h2>
      <div class="sub">Angka besar = minggu ini. Baris kecil = minggu pembanding dan persen perubahan.</div>
      <div class="tw"><table id="cCoach"></table></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel">
      <div class="filters" style="justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end">
        <div><h2>Perubahan per agent</h2><div class="sub">Siapa yang naik atau turun dibanding minggu pembanding</div></div>
        <div class="f"><label for="cS">Urutkan</label><select id="cS">
          <option value="dialAsc">Dial turun paling besar</option><option value="dialDesc">Dial naik paling besar</option>
          <option value="uAsc">Unique turun paling besar</option><option value="uDesc">Unique naik paling besar</option><option value="name">Nama agent</option></select></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tw"><table id="cAgent"></table></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <div class="stack" id="viewPerf" hidden>
    <section class="panel"><div class="filters">
      <div class="f"><label for="pfP">Periode</label><select id="pfP"></select></div>
      <div class="f"><label>Level tabel</label><div class="chips" id="pfLv"><button type="button" class="chip" data-lv="spv">Supervisor</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-lv="layer">Layer</button><button type="button" class="chip on" data-lv="coach">Coach</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-lv="agent">Agent</button></div></div>
    </div></section>
    <div class="note" id="pfNote"></div>
    <section class="kpis" id="pfK"></section>
    <section class="grid2">
      <div class="panel"><h2>Revenue vs target per minggu</h2><div class="sub">Target penuh per minggu. Minggu tanpa data transaksi tidak digambar.</div><div class="legend" id="pfLg1"></div><div id="pfCh1"></div></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2>Kumulatif revenue Oktober</h2><div class="sub">Aktual dibanding pace target bulan penuh</div><div class="legend" id="pfLg2"></div><div id="pfCh2"></div></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel"><h2 id="pfTT">Pencapaian per coach</h2><div class="sub">Target dihitung s.d. hari kerja yang sudah berjalan. Achievement = revenue ÷ target.</div><div class="tw"><table id="pfT"></table></div></section>
    <section class="grid2">
      <div class="panel"><h2>Rekap mingguan</h2><div class="sub">Mengikuti filter layer, coach, dan agent</div><div class="tw"><table id="pfW"></table></div></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2>Rekap harian dan kumulatif</h2><div class="sub">Revenue dan transaksi per tanggal</div><div class="tw"><table id="pfD"></table></div></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <div class="stack" id="viewPcmp" hidden>
    <section class="panel cmpctl">
      <div class="filters">
        <div class="f"><label>Jenis</label><div class="chips" id="xType"><button type="button" class="chip on" data-t="week">Week to week</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-t="day">Day to day</button></div></div>
        <div class="filters" id="xWk">
          <div class="f"><label for="xB">Minggu ini</label><select id="xB"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label for="xA">Dibanding minggu</label><select id="xA"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label for="xM">Basis</label><select id="xM"><option value="same">Hari yang sama</option><option value="total">Total minggu</option></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label>Pilihan cepat</label><div class="chips" id="xChips"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="filters" id="xDy" hidden>
          <div class="f"><label for="xdB">Hari</label><select id="xdB"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label for="xdA">Dibanding hari</label><select id="xdA"></select></div>
          <div class="f"><label>Pilihan cepat</label><div class="chips" id="xdChips"><button type="button" class="chip" data-act="latest">Hari terbaru vs sebelumnya</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-act="yday">vs kemarin</button><button type="button" class="chip" data-act="lw">vs hari sama minggu lalu</button></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    <div class="sub" id="xNote"></div>
    <section class="kpis" id="xKpis"></section>
    <section class="grid2">
      <div class="panel"><h2>Revenue per coach</h2><div class="sub">Pada basis yang dipilih</div><div class="legend" id="xLg1"></div><div id="xCh1"></div></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2>Transaksi per coach</h2><div class="sub">Jumlah invoice</div><div class="legend" id="xLg2"></div><div id="xCh2"></div></div>
    </section>
    <section class="grid2" id="xRow2">
      <div class="panel"><h2>Revenue per hari dalam minggu</h2><div class="sub">Sen sampai Min</div><div class="legend" id="xLg3"></div><div id="xCh3"></div></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2>Transaksi per hari dalam minggu</h2><div class="sub">Sen sampai Min</div><div class="legend" id="xLg4"></div><div id="xCh4"></div></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel"><h2>Perubahan per coach</h2><div class="sub">Angka besar = periode ini. Baris kecil = periode pembanding dan persen perubahan.</div><div class="tw"><table id="xCoach"></table></div></section>
    <section class="panel">
      <div class="filters" style="justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end">
        <div><h2>Perubahan per agent</h2><div class="sub">Agent yang bertransaksi di salah satu periode</div></div>
        <div class="f"><label for="xS">Urutkan</label><select id="xS"><option value="revAsc">Revenue turun paling besar</option><option value="revDesc">Revenue naik paling besar</option><option value="txnAsc">TXN turun paling besar</option><option value="txnDesc">TXN naik paling besar</option><option value="name">Nama agent</option></select></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tw"><table id="xAgent"></table></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <div class="stack" id="viewProd" hidden>
    <section class="panel"><div class="filters"><div class="f"><label for="prP">Periode</label><select id="prP"></select></div></div>
      <div class="sub" style="margin-top:10px"><b>Kategori</b> dihitung dari jumlah transaksi (TXN = invoice) per agent per minggu: <span class="cat h">High</span> 8 atau lebih · <span class="cat m">Medium</span> 1 sampai 7 · <span class="cat l">Low</span> kurang dari 1 (nol). Untuk minggu yang belum penuh, TXN diproyeksikan ke 1 minggu penuh sesuai workdays (tanda *). <b>Productivity</b> = TXN ÷ workdays (sheet Target &amp; Struktur, kolom H).</div></section>
    <section class="kpis" id="prK"></section>
    <section class="grid2">
      <div class="panel"><h2>Sebaran kategori</h2><div class="sub">Jumlah agent per kategori, per layer dan coach</div><div class="tw"><table id="prD"></table></div></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2>Tren kategori per minggu</h2><div class="sub">Jumlah agent di tiap kategori</div><div class="tw"><table id="prW"></table></div></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel"><h2>Productivity per agent</h2><div class="sub">Urut dari tertinggi. Titik warna pada kolom minggu = kategori agent di minggu itu.</div><div class="tw"><table id="prA"></table></div></section>
  </div>

  <footer>
    <div><b>Tersambung</b> = status Answered. <b>Call &gt; 5 menit</b> = call tersambung dengan durasi lebih dari 05:00. <b>Dial</b> = semua percobaan call, termasuk sibuk, tidak diangkat, dibatalkan, dan error.</div>
    <div><b>Unique number</b> = jumlah nomor tujuan yang berbeda yang di-dial satu agent dalam satu hari. Untuk rentang beberapa hari, unique per hari dijumlahkan, jadi nomor yang sama di hari berbeda dihitung lagi. <b>Dial / unique</b> = rata-rata berapa kali tiap nomor di-dial.</div>
    <div><b>Call Review</b>: basis hari yang sama = hanya hari (Sen sampai Min) yang ada di kedua minggu. Pada day to day, jam dapat disamakan sampai jam terakhir data hari terbaru, supaya hari yang belum penuh tetap adil. Warna hijau dan panah naik = peningkatan, oranye dan panah turun = penurunan.</div>
    <div><b>Performance</b>: Revenue = kolom Amount (Raw transaksi). TXN = jumlah invoice. Kategori per minggu: Low &lt; 1, Medium 1 sampai 7, High ≥ 8 transaksi. <b>Performance Review</b> membandingkan revenue dan transaksi antar minggu atau antar hari, data transaksi hanya per tanggal (tanpa jam).</div>
    <div id="src"></div>
  </footer>
