[4,4,1369875],[28,4,613350],[28,4,833780],[3,4,4140000],[34,4,2810880],[38,4,2520000],[33,4,3206660],[20,4,613350],[31,4,948460],[31,4,3611420],[32,4,871850],[11,4,1439999],[14,4,2086560],[35,4,497730],[20,4,497730],[12,4,325000],[24,4,1904000],[14,4,1093424],[43,4,693504],[8,4,497730],[25,4,3206660],[43,4,4260000],[5,4,497730],[27,4,779444],[26,4,613350],[26,4,8315000],[22,4,3206660],[6,4,689960],[2,4,1005160],[36,4,497730],[6,4,2047960],[20,3,497730],[7,3,618050],[2,3,1154960],[2,3,990800],[5,3,1342240],[1,3,2667360],[8,3,775970],[16,3,2603475],[43,3,106333],[25,3,1379136],[9,3,862450],[11,3,6048000],[12,3,497730],[21,3,3056660],[32,3,545670],[3,3,2986667],[17,3,1399999],[40,3,422730],[15,3,315488],[28,3,545670],[4,3,929172],[4,3,1393758],[4,3,1144960],[23,2,497730],[17,2,792000],[35,2,1316520],[1,2,159500],[33,2,159500],[20,2,497730],[20,2,159500],[21,2,1883002],[32,2,1543499],[41,2,759444],[13,2,681600],[15,2,3911200],[9,2,1702944],[25,2,785370],[18,2,3572000],[29,2,613350],[14,2,324997],[11,2,3105000],[11,2,5376000],[12,2,1848000],[5,2,613350],[5,2,1096728],[22,2,2455000],[7,2,1078224],[6,1,1767424],[36,1,1005160],[6,1,1199400],[39,1,871850],[39,1,785370],[26,1,2688000],[22,1,2162920],[2,1,497730],[19,1,733780],[10,1,1790500],[27,1,1940500],[10,1,1998000],[43,1,2655000],[24,1,4140000],[25,1,2928748],[12,1,618050],[32,1,1468600],[8,1,497730],[11,1,2073600],[28,1,1800000],[11,1,4200000],[0,1,4781500],[4,1,1349000],[0,1,4140000],[4,1,689960],[0,1,2100000],[3,1,2016000],[8,1,325000],[29,1,497730],[38,1,783816],[41,1,497730],[42,1,618050],[13,1,1257300],[13,1,618050],[9,1,1539888],[15,1,2577658],[13,0,1076400],[34,0,1175724],[15,0,3584159],[38,0,2667360],[38,0,2100000],[38,0,2100000],[0,0,1440000],[3,0,9648000],[31,0,613350],[29,0,3761420],[30,0,325000],[21,0,497729],[32,0,613350],[12,0,1400000],[25,0,1940500],[24,0,1736000],[24,0,1439999],[24,0,1440000],[27,0,3206660],[5,0,1940500],[19,0,497730],[10,0,2784400],[26,0,3174000],[10,0,4691000],[22,0,497730],[22,0,2026000],[26,0,1223424],[17,0,792000],[6,0,191400],[7,0,497730],[6,0,618050],[7,0,325000]],"outside":2,"outsideRev":1557924}};
const A = D.agents, DATES = D.dates;
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const BL='var(--blue)', OR='var(--orange)', NE='var(--neutral)';
const fmtN = n => n.toLocaleString('id-ID');
const pct = (a,b) => b ? (a/b*100).toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+'%' : '–';
const mmss = s => { s=Math.round(s); return String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(s%60).padStart(2,'0'); };
const hm = s => { const h=Math.floor(s/3600), m=Math.round(s%3600/60); return h? h+'j '+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+'m' : m+'m'; };
const DAYN=['Min','Sen','Sel','Rab','Kam','Jum','Sab'], MONN=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','Mei','Jun','Jul','Agu','Sep','Okt','Nov','Des'];
const dObj = s => new Date(s+'T00:00:00Z');
const dLab = s => { const d=dObj(s); return DAYN[d.getUTCDay()]+', '+d.getUTCDate()+' '+MONN[d.getUTCMonth()]; };
const dShort = s => { const d=dObj(s); return d.getUTCDate()+' '+MONN[d.getUTCMonth()]; };
const monday = s => { const d=dObj(s); const w=(d.getUTCDay()+6)%7; d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()-w); return d.toISOString().slice(0,10); };
const isoW = s => { const d=dObj(s); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()-((d.getUTCDay()+6)%7)+3); const j=new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(),0,4)); return 1+Math.round(((d-j)/864e5-3+((j.getUTCDay()+6)%7))/7); };
const addDays = (s,n) => { const d=dObj(s); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+n); return d.toISOString().slice(0,10); };
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));

let TAB='dash';
const S = {date:'all', layer:'all', coach:'all', q:'', sort:{k:'dials',dir:-1}, showAll:false};
try{ const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cat_f')||'{}'); if(s.layer) S.layer=s.layer; if(s.coach) S.coach=s.coach; }catch(e){}

// ---------- filters ----------
const coaches = [...new Set(A.map(a=>a.c))];
const layers = [...new Set(A.map(a=>a.l))];
function opt(el, items, sel){ el.innerHTML = items.map(([v,t])=>`<option value="${esc(v)}"${v===sel?' selected':''}>${esc(t)}</option>`).join(''); }
const DW = DATES.map(isoW), WEEKS=[...new Set(DW)];
const wRange = w => { const m=monday(DATES[DW.indexOf(w)]); return dShort(m)+' – '+dShort(addDays(m,6)); };
const wName = w => { const d=dObj(monday(DATES[DW.indexOf(w)])); return 'W'+w+' · W'+Math.ceil(d.getUTCDate()/7)+' '+MONN[d.getUTCMonth()]; };
if(WEEKS.length>1){ const full=WEEKS.filter(w=>DW.filter(x=>x===w).length>=5); S.date='w'+(full.length?full[full.length-1]:WEEKS[WEEKS.length-1]); }
$('fDate').innerHTML = `<option value="all">Kumulatif Oktober · ${DATES.length} hari data</option><optgroup label="Minggu ISO">`+WEEKS.map(w=>`<option value="w${w}">${wName(w)} · ${wRange(w)}</option>`).join('')+`</optgroup><optgroup label="Per hari">`+DATES.map((d,i)=>`<option value="d${i}">${dLab(d)}</option>`).reverse().join('')+`</optgroup>`;
$('fDate').value=S.date;
const inDate = r => S.date==='all' || (S.date[0]==='w' ? DW[r[1]]===+S.date.slice(1) : r[1]===+S.date.slice(1));
const periodLabel = () => S.date==='all' ? (DATES.length>1? dShort(DATES[0])+' – '+dShort(DATES[DATES.length-1]) : dLab(DATES[0])) : S.date[0]==='w' ? 'W'+S.date.slice(1)+' · '+wRange(+S.date.slice(1)) : dLab(DATES[+S.date.slice(1)]);
opt($('fLayer'), [['all','Semua layer'], ...layers.map(l=>[l,l])], S.layer);
opt($('fCoach'), [['all','Semua coach'], ...coaches.map(c=>[c,c])], S.coach);
['fDate','fLayer','fCoach'].forEach(id=>$(id).addEventListener('change',e=>{
  const v=e.target.value; if(id==='fDate')S.date=v; if(id==='fLayer')S.layer=v; if(id==='fCoach')S.coach=v;
  try{localStorage.setItem('cat_f',JSON.stringify({layer:S.layer,coach:S.coach}))}catch(_){}
  render();}));
$('fQ').addEventListener('input',e=>{S.q=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();render();});

const agentOk = i => { const a=A[i]; return (S.layer==='all'||a.l===S.layer)&&(S.coach==='all'||a.c===S.coach)&&(!S.q||a.n.toLowerCase().includes(S.q)); };

// ---------- aggregation ----------
function agg(rows){
  const o={dials:0,u:0,ans:0,g5:0,talk:0,max:0,ansTalk:0,days:new Set()};
  for(const r of rows){ o.dials++; o.u+=r[6]; o.days.add(r[1]); if(r[4]){o.ans++; o.talk+=r[5]; if(r[5]>o.max)o.max=r[5]; if(r[5]>300)o.g5++;} }
  return o;
}
function render(){
  if(TAB==='cmp'){ renderCmp(); return; }
  if(TAB==='perf'){ renderPerf(); return; }
  if(TAB==='pcmp'){ renderPcmp(); return; }
  if(TAB==='prod'){ renderProd(); return; }
  const inAgent = D.calls.filter(r=>agentOk(r[0]));          // agent filters only
  const rows = inAgent.filter(inDate);
  const T0 = agg(rows);
  const activeAgents = new Set(rows.map(r=>r[0])).size;
  const totalAgents = A.filter((_,i)=>agentOk(i)).length;
  $('meta').textContent = `SPV ${D.spv} · ${D.label} · ${periodLabel()} · ${totalAgents} agent`;
  $('src').textContent = `Sumber: log call omni_sip_log. Data terakhir ${D.lastTs.replace(' ',' pukul ').replace('.',':')} WIB.`;
  const nd = new Set(rows.map(r=>r[1])).size;
  if(DATES.length===1){ $('note').hidden=false; $('note').textContent='File ini baru berisi 1 hari ('+dLab(DATES[0])+'). Rekap mingguan dan rata-rata per minggu akan terisi penuh setelah data hari lain ditambahkan.'; } else $('note').hidden=true;

  // KPIs
  const avgAns = T0.ans? T0.talk/T0.ans : 0;
  $('kpis').innerHTML = [
    ['Total dial', fmtN(T0.dials), `${activeAgents} dari ${totalAgents} agent aktif`,''],
    ['Unique number', fmtN(T0.u), `${T0.u?(T0.dials/T0.u).toFixed(2).replace('.',','):'–'} dial per nomor`,''],
    ['Rata-rata dial / agent', activeAgents? fmtN(Math.round(T0.dials/activeAgents/Math.max(nd,1))):'0', 'per agent aktif per hari',''],
    ['Tersambung', fmtN(T0.ans), pct(T0.ans,T0.dials)+' dari dial',''],
    ['Call > 5 menit', fmtN(T0.g5), pct(T0.g5,T0.ans)+' dari tersambung','hi'],
    ['Total durasi bicara', hm(T0.talk), 'rata-rata '+mmss(avgAns)+' per call tersambung',''],
    ['Call terlama', T0.max? mmss(T0.max):'–', 'menit:detik','']
  ].map(([l,v,n,c])=>`<div class="kpi ${c}"><span class="l">${l}</span><span class="v">${v}</span><span class="n">${n}</span></div>`).join('');

  // hour charts
  const hrs=[...new Set(D.calls.map(r=>r[2]))]; const h0=Math.min(...hrs), h1=Math.max(...hrs);
  const hours=[]; for(let h=h0;h<=h1;h++)hours.push(h);
  const byH = h=>rows.filter(r=>r[2]===h);
  const hd = hours.map(h=>{const x=byH(h); const a=x.filter(r=>r[4]).length; return {h, tot:x.length, ans:a, g5:x.filter(r=>r[4]&&r[5]>300).length};});
  $('chHour').innerHTML = barChart(hd.map(d=>({label:String(d.h).padStart(2,'0')+':00', parts:[[d.ans,BL,'Tersambung'],[d.tot-d.ans,NE,'Tidak tersambung']], total:d.tot, tip:`${String(d.h).padStart(2,'0')}:00–${String(d.h).padStart(2,'0')}:59<br>Dial ${fmtN(d.tot)} · tersambung ${fmtN(d.ans)} (${pct(d.ans,d.tot)})`})));
  $('chLong').innerHTML = barChart(hd.map(d=>({label:String(d.h).padStart(2,'0')+':00', parts:[[d.g5,OR,'> 5 menit']], total:d.g5, tip:`${String(d.h).padStart(2,'0')}:00–${String(d.h).padStart(2,'0')}:59<br>${d.g5} call > 5 menit`})));

  // duration distribution
  const ansRows = rows.filter(r=>r[4]);
  const bk=[['0–10 detik',0,10],['11–60 detik',11,60],['1–3 menit',61,180],['3–5 menit',181,300],['> 5 menit',301,1e9]];
  const cnt=bk.map(([l,a,b])=>({l,n:ansRows.filter(r=>r[5]>=a&&r[5]<=b).length}));
  const mx=Math.max(1,...cnt.map(c=>c.n));
  $('distSub').textContent = `${fmtN(ansRows.length)} call tersambung`;
  $('dist').innerHTML = cnt.map((c,i)=>`<div class="r"><span>${c.l}</span><div class="tr"><b style="width:${c.n/mx*100}%;background:${i===4?OR:BL}"></b></div><span class="c">${fmtN(c.n)} · ${pct(c.n,ansRows.length)}</span></div>`).join('');

  // coach table
  const cs = coaches.filter(c=>(S.coach==='all'||c===S.coach)).map(c=>{
    const idxs=A.map((a,i)=>a.c===c&&agentOk(i)?i:-1).filter(i=>i>=0);
    const set=new Set(idxs); const rr=rows.filter(r=>set.has(r[0])); const g=agg(rr);
    const act=new Set(rr.map(r=>r[0])).size;
    return {c, l:A[idxs[0]]?.l||'', tot:idxs.length, act, g, nd:Math.max(new Set(rr.map(r=>r[1])).size,1)};
  }).filter(x=>x.tot>0);
  $('tCoach').innerHTML = `<thead><tr><th>Coach</th><th>Agent aktif</th><th>Dial</th><th>Unique</th><th>Dial / agent / hari</th><th>Tersambung</th><th>&gt; 5 mnt</th></tr></thead><tbody>`+
    cs.map(x=>`<tr><td>${esc(x.c)}<span class="sm">${x.l}</span></td><td class="num">${x.act}/${x.tot}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.g.dials)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.g.u)}</td><td class="num">${x.act?Math.round(x.g.dials/x.act/x.nd):0}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.g.ans)} <span class="sm">${pct(x.g.ans,x.g.dials)}</span></td><td class="num">${x.g.g5}</td></tr>`).join('')+`</tbody>`;

  // daily recap (agent filters only, all days)
  const dayRows = DATES.map((d,i)=>{const rr=inAgent.filter(r=>r[1]===i); const g=agg(rr); const act=new Set(rr.map(r=>r[0])).size; return {d,i,g,act};});
  { let cd=0,cu=0,ca=0,c5=0; dayRows.forEach(x=>{cd+=x.g.dials;cu+=x.g.u;ca+=x.g.ans;c5+=x.g.g5;x.cd=cd;x.cu=cu;x.ca=ca;x.c5=c5;}); }
  $('chDay').innerHTML = barChart(dayRows.map(x=>({label:String(dObj(x.d).getUTCDate()),parts:[[x.g.ans,BL,'Tersambung'],[x.g.dials-x.g.ans,NE,'Tidak tersambung']],total:x.g.dials,tip:`${dLab(x.d)}<br>Dial ${fmtN(x.g.dials)} · unique ${fmtN(x.g.u)}<br>Tersambung ${fmtN(x.g.ans)} (${pct(x.g.ans,x.g.dials)})`})));
  $('chCum').innerHTML = lineChart(dayRows.map(x=>String(dObj(x.d).getUTCDate())),[{vals:dayRows.map(x=>x.cd),color:BL},{vals:dayRows.map(x=>x.cu),color:'var(--serA)'},{vals:dayRows.map(x=>x.ca),color:'var(--orange)'}],fmtN,i=>`${dLab(dayRows[i].d)}<br>Kumulatif dial ${fmtN(dayRows[i].cd)}<br>Unique ${fmtN(dayRows[i].cu)}<br>Tersambung ${fmtN(dayRows[i].ca)}<br>&gt; 5 menit ${fmtN(dayRows[i].c5)}`);
  $('tDay').innerHTML = `<thead><tr><th>Hari</th><th>Agent aktif</th><th>Dial</th><th>Unique</th><th>Dial / agent</th><th>Tersambung</th><th>&gt; 5 mnt</th><th>Kumulatif dial</th><th>Kumulatif unique</th><th>Kumulatif &gt; 5 mnt</th></tr></thead><tbody>`+
    dayRows.map(x=>`<tr><td>${dLab(x.d)}${x.d===D.lastTs.slice(0,10)?'<span class="sm">sampai '+D.lastTs.slice(11).replace('.',':')+'</span>':''}</td><td class="num">${x.act}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.g.dials)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.g.u)}</td><td class="num">${x.act?Math.round(x.g.dials/x.act):0}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.g.ans)} <span class="sm">${pct(x.g.ans,x.g.dials)}</span></td><td class="num">${x.g.g5}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.cd)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.cu)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(x.c5)}</td></tr>`).join('')+`</tbody>`;

  // weekly recap
  const wk={}; dayRows.forEach(x=>{const m=monday(x.d); (wk[m]=wk[m]||[]).push(x);});
  const wrows = Object.entries(wk).map(([m,xs])=>{
    const dl=xs.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.g.dials,0), an=xs.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.g.ans,0), g5=xs.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.g.g5,0), tk=xs.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.g.talk,0);
    const idxSet=new Set(xs.map(x=>x.i)); const act=new Set(inAgent.filter(r=>idxSet.has(r[1])).map(r=>r[0])).size;
    const u=xs.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.g.u,0); return {m,days:xs.length,dl,u,an,g5,tk,act};
  });
  { let c=0; wrows.forEach(w=>{ c+=w.dl; w.cd=c; }); }
  const wl=m=>'W'+isoW(m)+' · '+dShort(m)+' – '+dShort(addDays(m,6));
  let wh=`<thead><tr><th>ISO Week</th><th>Hari data</th><th>Dial</th><th>Unique</th><th>Dial / agent aktif</th><th>Tersambung</th><th>&gt; 5 mnt</th><th>Kumulatif dial</th></tr></thead><tbody>`+
    wrows.map(w=>`<tr><td>${wl(w.m)}</td><td class="num">${w.days}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(w.dl)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(w.u)}</td><td class="num">${w.act?Math.round(w.dl/w.act):0}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(w.an)} <span class="sm">${pct(w.an,w.dl)}</span></td><td class="num">${w.g5}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(w.cd)}</td></tr>`).join('');
  { const S2=k=>wrows.reduce((s,w)=>s+w[k],0); const actAll=new Set(inAgent.map(r=>r[0])).size; wh+=`<tr class="tot"><td>Total Oktober (kumulatif)</td><td class="num">${S2('days')}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(S2('dl'))}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(S2('u'))}</td><td class="num">${actAll?Math.round(S2('dl')/actAll):0}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(S2('an'))} <span class="sm">${pct(S2('an'),S2('dl'))}</span></td><td class="num">${S2('g5')}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(S2('dl'))}</td></tr>`; }
  if(wrows.length>1){const n=wrows.length; const av=k=>Math.round(wrows.reduce((s,w)=>s+w[k],0)/n); wh+=`<tr class="tot"><td>Rata-rata / minggu</td><td class="num">${(wrows.reduce((s,w)=>s+w.days,0)/n).toFixed(1).replace('.',',')}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(av('dl'))}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(av('u'))}</td><td class="num">${av('act')?Math.round(av('dl')/av('act')):0}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(av('an'))}</td><td class="num">${av('g5')}</td><td></td></tr>`;}
  $('tWeek').innerHTML = wh+'</tbody>';

  // agent table
  const per = A.map((a,i)=>({i,a,g:agg(rows.filter(r=>r[0]===i))})).filter(x=>agentOk(x.i));
  const rowDays=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[1]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b), rowWeeks=[...new Set(rowDays.map(i=>DW[i]))];
  let colOf=null, dayCols=[];
  const cmode=(S.colMode||'auto')==='auto'?(rowWeeks.length>1?'week':'day'):S.colMode;
  $('colMode').querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.m===cmode));
  if(cmode==='week'&&rowWeeks.length>1){ dayCols=rowWeeks.map(w=>'W'+w); colOf=r=>rowWeeks.indexOf(DW[r[1]]); }
  else if(rowDays.length>1){ dayCols=rowDays.map(i=>dShort(DATES[i])); colOf=r=>rowDays.indexOf(r[1]); }
  const cc={}; if(colOf) rows.forEach(r=>{ (cc[r[0]]=cc[r[0]]||new Array(dayCols.length).fill(0))[colOf(r)]++; });
  const multiW=rowWeeks.length>1;
  per.forEach(x=>{ x.dials=x.g.dials; x.u=x.g.u; x.rep=x.g.u?x.g.dials/x.g.u:0; x.ans=x.g.ans; x.rate=x.g.dials? x.g.ans/x.g.dials:-1; x.g5=x.g.g5; x.talk=x.g.talk; x.avg=x.g.ans? x.g.talk/x.g.ans:0; x.max=x.g.max; x.avgDay=x.g.days.size? x.g.dials/x.g.days.size:0; x.name=x.a.n; x.coach=x.a.c;
    x.dd = cc[x.i]||new Array(dayCols.length).fill(0); x.avgWk = x.g.days.size? x.g.dials/new Set([...x.g.days].map(i=>DW[i])).size:0; });
  const k=S.sort.k, dir=S.sort.dir;
  per.sort((p,q)=> (typeof p[k]==='string'? p[k].localeCompare(q[k]) : p[k]-q[k])*dir || q.dials-p.dials);
  const maxD=Math.max(1,...per.map(x=>x.dials));
  const cols=[['name','Agent'],['dials','Dial'],['u','Unique'],['rep','Dial / unique'],['ans','Tersambung'],['rate','% Sambung'],['g5','> 5 mnt'],['talk','Total bicara'],['avg','Rata-rata'],['max','Terlama']];
  const arrow=c=>S.sort.k===c?`<span class="ar">${S.sort.dir<0?' ▼':' ▲'}</span>`:'';
  let th=cols.map(([c,t])=>`<th data-k="${c}" tabindex="0" role="button">${t}${arrow(c)}</th>`).join('')+dayCols.map(l=>`<th>${l}</th>`).join('')+(dayCols.length?'<th data-k="avgDay" tabindex="0" role="button">Rata-rata/hari'+arrow('avgDay')+'</th>':'')+(multiW?'<th data-k="avgWk" tabindex="0" role="button">Rata-rata/minggu'+arrow('avgWk')+'</th>':'');
  const body = per.map(x=>`<tr><td>${esc(x.name)}<span class="sm">${esc(x.coach)} · ${x.a.l}</span></td>
    <td class="num"><div class="bar"><span class="t"><b style="width:${x.ans/maxD*90}px;background:${BL}"></b><b style="width:${(x.dials-x.ans)/maxD*90}px;background:${NE}"></b></span>${fmtN(x.dials)}</div></td>
    <td class="num">${x.dials?fmtN(x.u):'–'}</td><td class="num">${x.dials?x.rep.toFixed(2).replace('.',','):'–'}</td>
    <td class="num">${x.dials?fmtN(x.ans):'–'}</td><td class="num">${x.dials?pct(x.ans,x.dials):'<span class="tag warn">Tidak ada call</span>'}</td>
    <td class="num">${x.dials?`<span class="pill ${x.g5?'':'z'}">${x.g5}</span>`:'–'}</td>
    <td class="num">${x.dials?hm(x.talk):'–'}</td><td class="num">${x.ans?mmss(x.avg):'–'}</td><td class="num">${x.max?mmss(x.max):'–'}</td>
    ${x.dd.map(v=>`<td class="num">${v||'–'}</td>`).join('')}${dayCols.length?`<td class="num">${x.dials?Math.round(x.avgDay):'–'}</td>`:''}${multiW?`<td class="num">${x.dials?fmtN(Math.round(x.avgWk)):'–'}</td>`:''}</tr>`).join('');
  const sum=per.reduce((s,x)=>({d:s.d+x.dials,u:s.u+x.u,a:s.a+x.ans,g:s.g+x.g5,t:s.t+x.talk}),{d:0,u:0,a:0,g:0,t:0});
  const foot=`<tr class="tot"><td>Total ${per.length} agent</td><td class="num">${fmtN(sum.d)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(sum.u)}</td><td class="num">${sum.u?(sum.d/sum.u).toFixed(2).replace('.',','):'–'}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(sum.a)}</td><td class="num">${pct(sum.a,sum.d)}</td><td class="num">${sum.g}</td><td class="num">${hm(sum.t)}</td><td class="num">${sum.a?mmss(sum.t/sum.a):'–'}</td><td class="num">${per.length?mmss(Math.max(...per.map(x=>x.max))):'–'}</td>${dayCols.map((di,j)=>`<td class="num">${fmtN(per.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.dd[j],0))}</td>`).join('')}${dayCols.length?'<td></td>':''}${multiW?'<td></td>':''}</tr>`;
  $('tAgent').innerHTML=`<thead><tr>${th}</tr></thead><tbody>${body}${foot}</tbody>`;
  $('tAgent').querySelectorAll('th[data-k]').forEach(el=>{
    const go=()=>{const c=el.dataset.k; S.sort = S.sort.k===c? {k:c,dir:-S.sort.dir} : {k:c,dir:c==='name'?1:-1}; render();};
    el.addEventListener('click',go); el.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();go();}});});

  // long call list
  const longs = rows.filter(r=>r[4]&&r[5]>300).sort((a,b)=>b[5]-a[5]);
  $('longSub').textContent = longs.length? `${longs.length} call · durasi ${mmss(longs[longs.length-1][5])} sampai ${mmss(longs[0][5])} · nomor tujuan disamarkan` : 'Tidak ada call > 5 menit pada filter ini';
  const shown = S.showAll? longs : longs.slice(0,15);
  $('tLong').innerHTML = longs.length? `<thead><tr><th>Agent</th><th>Tanggal</th><th>Mulai</th><th>Durasi</th><th>Tujuan</th></tr></thead><tbody>`+shown.map(r=>`<tr><td>${esc(A[r[0]].n)}<span class="sm">${esc(A[r[0]].c)}</span></td><td>${dShort(DATES[r[1]])}</td><td class="num">${String(r[2]).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(r[3]).padStart(2,'0')}</td><td class="num"><span class="pill">${mmss(r[5])}</span></td><td class="num">${r[7]}</td></tr>`).join('')+'</tbody>' : '';
  const mb=$('moreBtn'); mb.hidden = longs.length<=15; mb.textContent = S.showAll? 'Tampilkan 15 teratas' : `Tampilkan semua (${longs.length})`;
}
$('moreBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{S.showAll=!S.showAll;render();});

// ---------- SVG bar chart ----------
function niceMax(v){ if(v<=0)return 4; const q=v/4, p=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(q))); const u=[1,2,5,10].map(m=>m*p).find(x=>x>=q); return u*4; }
function barChart(items){
  const W=560,H=230,L=38,R=8,T=16,B=26, iw=W-L-R, ih=H-T-B;
  const mx=niceMax(Math.max(1,...items.map(i=>i.total))), n=items.length, step=iw/n, bw=Math.min(40,step*0.62);
  let s=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Grafik batang per jam">`;
  for(let t=0;t<=4;t++){ const v=mx/4*t, y=T+ih-ih*t/4; s+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="1"/><text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end">${Number.isInteger(v)?v:v.toFixed(1)}</text>`; }
  items.forEach((it,i)=>{
    const cx=L+step*i+step/2, x=cx-bw/2; let y=T+ih;
    it.parts.forEach(([v,c],pi)=>{ if(v<=0)return; const h=ih*v/mx; const gap=pi>0?2:0; s+=`<rect x="${x}" y="${y-h}" width="${bw}" height="${Math.max(h-gap,0.5)}" rx="2" fill="${c}"/>`; y-=h; });
    s+=`<text class="val" x="${cx}" y="${y-4}" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:${n>10?9:11}px">${it.total?(n>10?fmtK(it.total):fmtN(it.total)):''}</text><text x="${cx}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle">${it.label}</text>`;
    s+=`<rect x="${L+step*i}" y="${T}" width="${step}" height="${ih}" fill="transparent" data-tip="${esc(it.tip)}"/>`;
  });
  return s+'</svg>';
}

// ---------- tooltip ----------
const tip=$('tip');
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  const t=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('[data-tip]');
  if(!t){tip.style.display='none';return;}
  tip.innerHTML=t.getAttribute('data-tip'); tip.style.display='block';
  const w=tip.offsetWidth; tip.style.left=Math.min(e.clientX+12,innerWidth-w-8)+'px'; tip.style.top=(e.clientY+14)+'px';
});
document.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>tip.style.display='none');
// ---------- comparison tab ----------
const DWD = DATES.map(s=>(dObj(s).getUTCDay()+6)%7);
const WDN = ['Sen','Sel','Rab','Kam','Jum','Sab','Min'];
const LASTIDX = DATES.length-1;
const lastMin = DATES.map(()=>0); D.calls.forEach(r=>{ const m=r[2]*60+r[3]; if(m>lastMin[r[1]]) lastMin[r[1]]=m; });
const hhmm = m => String(Math.floor(m/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(m%60).padStart(2,'0');
const dName = i => { const d=dObj(DATES[i]); return ['Min','Sen','Sel','Rab','Kam','Jum','Sab'][d.getUTCDay()]+' '+d.getUTCDate()+' '+MONN[d.getUTCMonth()]; };
const idxOfDate = (i,off) => DATES.indexOf(addDays(DATES[i],off));
const CMP = {type:'week',a:null,b:null,mode:'same',sort:'dialAsc',da:null,db:null,dm:'cut',dmAuto:true};
CMP.db=LASTIDX; CMP.da=idxOfDate(LASTIDX,-1); if(CMP.da<0) CMP.da=Math.max(0,LASTIDX-1);
if(DATES.length<2) $('tabCmp').hidden=true;
if(WEEKS.length>=2){
  const full=WEEKS.filter(w=>DW.filter(x=>x===w).length>=5);
  CMP.b = full.length? full[full.length-1] : WEEKS[WEEKS.length-1];
  const ix=WEEKS.indexOf(CMP.b); CMP.a = WEEKS[ix>0?ix-1:ix+1];
  const wo=sel=>WEEKS.map(w=>`<option value="${w}"${w===sel?' selected':''}>${wName(w)} · ${wRange(w)}</option>`).join('');
  $('cB').innerHTML=wo(CMP.b); $('cA').innerHTML=wo(CMP.a);
  $('cChips').innerHTML=WEEKS.slice(1).map((w,i)=>`<button type="button" class="chip" data-b="${w}" data-a="${WEEKS[i]}">W${w} vs W${WEEKS[i]}</button>`).join('');
  $('cB').addEventListener('change',e=>{CMP.b=+e.target.value;renderCmp();});
  $('cA').addEventListener('change',e=>{CMP.a=+e.target.value;renderCmp();});
  $('cM').addEventListener('change',e=>{CMP.mode=e.target.value;renderCmp();});
  $('cChips').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b)return; CMP.b=+b.dataset.b; CMP.a=+b.dataset.a; $('cB').value=CMP.b; $('cA').value=CMP.a; renderCmp();});
} else { CMP.type='day'; $('cType').querySelector('[data-t=week]').hidden=true; }
const dopts=sel=>DATES.map((d,i)=>`<option value="${i}"${i===sel?' selected':''}>${dLab(d)}</option>`).reverse().join('');
$('dB').innerHTML=dopts(CMP.db); $('dA').innerHTML=dopts(CMP.da);
$('dM').innerHTML=`<option value="cut">Sampai ${hhmm(lastMin[LASTIDX])} (samakan jam)</option><option value="full">Seluruh hari</option>`;
function autoDm(){ if(CMP.dmAuto){ CMP.dm=(CMP.db===LASTIDX||CMP.da===LASTIDX)?'cut':'full'; $('dM').value=CMP.dm; } }
function syncDay(){ $('dB').value=CMP.db; $('dA').value=CMP.da; autoDm(); renderCmp(); }
$('dB').addEventListener('change',e=>{CMP.db=+e.target.value;autoDm();renderCmp();});
$('dA').addEventListener('change',e=>{CMP.da=+e.target.value;autoDm();renderCmp();});
$('dM').addEventListener('change',e=>{CMP.dm=e.target.value;CMP.dmAuto=false;renderCmp();});
$('dChips').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b)return; const act=b.dataset.act;
  if(act==='latest'){ CMP.db=LASTIDX; CMP.da=idxOfDate(LASTIDX,-1); if(CMP.da<0)CMP.da=Math.max(0,LASTIDX-1); }
  else { const n=idxOfDate(CMP.db, act==='yday'?-1:-7); if(n<0){ return; } CMP.da=n; }
  CMP.dmAuto=true; syncDay();
});
$('cS').addEventListener('change',e=>{CMP.sort=e.target.value;renderCmp();});
$('cType').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b)return; CMP.type=b.dataset.t; renderCmp();});
const TABS={dash:['viewDash','tabDash'],cmp:['viewCmp','tabCmp'],perf:['viewPerf','tabPerf'],pcmp:['viewPcmp','tabPcmp'],prod:['viewProd','tabProd']};
function setTab(k){
  TAB=k; Object.entries(TABS).forEach(([n,[v,b]])=>{ $(v).hidden=n!==k; $(b).classList.toggle('on',n===k); });
  $('fPeriodWrap').hidden=k!=='dash'; render();
}
Object.entries(TABS).forEach(([n,[v,b]])=>$(b).addEventListener('click',()=>setTab(n)));
$('colMode').addEventListener('click',e=>{ const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b) return; S.colMode=b.dataset.m; render(); });

const fmtK = v => v>=1000 ? (v/1000).toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+'k' : String(v);
const fmtRate = v => (v*100).toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+'%';
function dchip(b,a){
  if(!a&&!b) return '<span class="dl flat">–</span>';
  if(!a) return '<span class="dl up">▲ baru</span>';
  const p=(b-a)/a*100, c=Math.abs(p)<0.5?'flat':p>0?'up':'down';
  return `<span class="dl ${c}">${p>0.05?'▲':p<-0.05?'▼':'■'} ${p>0?'+':''}${p.toFixed(1).replace('.',',')}%</span>`;
}
function pchip(b,a){
  const d=(b-a)*100, c=Math.abs(d)<0.05?'flat':d>0?'up':'down';
  return `<span class="dl ${c}">${d>0.05?'▲':d<-0.05?'▼':'■'} ${d>0?'+':''}${d.toFixed(1).replace('.',',')} poin</span>`;
}
function met(rows){
  const g=agg(rows), act=new Set(rows.map(r=>r[0])).size;
  return {dials:g.dials,u:g.u,ans:g.ans,g5:g.g5,talk:g.talk,act,rate:g.dials?g.ans/g.dials:0,perAgent:act?g.dials/act:0};
}
function cell(b,a,f,pt){ return `<td class="num">${f(b)}<span class="sm">${f(a)} · ${pt?pchip(b,a):dchip(b,a)}</span></td>`; }

function groupedBar(cats,SA,SB,la,lb,tipf,fm){
  fm=fm||{v:fmtK,t:fmtN};
  const W=560,H=230,L=54,R=8,T=18,Bt=28, iw=W-L-R, ih=H-T-Bt;
  const vals=[...SA,...SB].filter(v=>v!=null);
  const mx=niceMax(Math.max(1,...vals)), n=cats.length, step=iw/n, bw=Math.min(26,step*0.36);
  let s=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Grafik batang perbandingan">`;
  for(let t=0;t<=4;t++){ const v=mx/4*t, y=T+ih-ih*t/4; s+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="1"/><text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end">${fm.t(v)}</text>`; }
  cats.forEach((c,i)=>{
    const cx=L+step*i+step/2;
    [[SA[i],'var(--serA)',cx-bw-1],[SB[i],BL,cx+1]].forEach(([v,col,x])=>{
      if(v==null) return; const h=ih*v/mx;
      s+=`<rect x="${x}" y="${T+ih-h}" width="${bw}" height="${Math.max(h,0.5)}" rx="2" fill="${col}"/><text class="val" x="${x+bw/2}" y="${T+ih-h-4}" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:10px">${(v&&cats.length<=9)?fm.v(v):''}</text>`;
    });
    s+=`<text x="${cx}" y="${H-9}" text-anchor="middle">${esc(c)}</text><rect x="${L+step*i}" y="${T}" width="${step}" height="${ih}" fill="transparent" data-tip="${esc(tipf(i))}"/>`;
  });
  return s+'</svg>';
}


function renderCmp(){
  const inA=D.calls.filter(r=>agentOk(r[0]));
  const isWeek=CMP.type==='week';
  $('cType').querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.t===CMP.type));
  $('wkCtl').hidden=!isWeek; $('dyCtl').hidden=isWeek;
  let RA,RB,la,lb,note,chart;
  if(isWeek){
    const dayIdx=w=>DATES.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>DW[i]===w);
    const wdOf=w=>new Set(dayIdx(w).map(i=>DWD[i]));
    let common=null;
    if(CMP.mode==='same'){ const sb=wdOf(CMP.b); common=new Set([...wdOf(CMP.a)].filter(x=>sb.has(x))); if(!common.size) common=null; }
    const pw=DWD[LASTIDX], pwk=DW[LASTIDX], cutMin=lastMin[LASTIDX];
    const cutW=!!(common&&common.has(pw)&&(CMP.a===pwk||CMP.b===pwk));
    const pick=w=>inA.filter(r=>DW[r[1]]===w&&(!common||common.has(DWD[r[1]]))&&!(cutW&&DWD[r[1]]===pw&&r[2]*60+r[3]>cutMin));
    RA=pick(CMP.a); RB=pick(CMP.b); la='W'+CMP.a; lb='W'+CMP.b;
    const nd=w=>dayIdx(w).length;
    note=`<b>${wName(CMP.b)}</b> (${wRange(CMP.b)}) dibanding <b>${wName(CMP.a)}</b> (${wRange(CMP.a)}). `;
    if(CMP.a===CMP.b) note+='Kedua minggu sama, pilih minggu pembanding yang berbeda. ';
    if(common) note+=`Basis hari yang sama: ${[...common].sort().map(i=>WDN[i]).join(', ')}.`;
    else { note+=`Basis total minggu: ${nd(CMP.b)} hari data vs ${nd(CMP.a)} hari data.`; if(nd(CMP.a)!==nd(CMP.b)) note+=' Jumlah hari berbeda, pilih basis "Hari yang sama" agar adil.'; }
    if(cutW) note+=` ${WDN[pw]} dibatasi sampai pukul ${hhmm(cutMin)} di kedua minggu karena data hari terbaru belum penuh.`;
    const dowArr=w=>{ const a=Array(7).fill(null); dayIdx(w).forEach(i=>{a[DWD[i]]=0;}); inA.forEach(r=>{ if(DW[r[1]]===w) a[DWD[r[1]]]++; }); return a; };
    const dA=dowArr(CMP.a), dB=dowArr(CMP.b);
    chart={title:'Dial per hari dalam minggu',sub:'Sen sampai Min, hari tanpa data tidak digambar. Hari terbaru bisa belum penuh.',cats:WDN,A:dA,B:dB,tip:i=>`${WDN[i]}<br>${la}: ${dA[i]==null?'tidak ada data':fmtN(dA[i])}<br>${lb}: ${dB[i]==null?'tidak ada data':fmtN(dB[i])}`};
  } else {
    const cut=CMP.dm==='cut'?lastMin[LASTIDX]:1e9;
    const pk=i=>inA.filter(r=>r[1]===i&&r[2]*60+r[3]<=cut);
    RA=pk(CMP.da); RB=pk(CMP.db); la=dName(CMP.da); lb=dName(CMP.db);
    note=`<b>${dLab(DATES[CMP.db])}</b> dibanding <b>${dLab(DATES[CMP.da])}</b>. `+(CMP.da===CMP.db?'Kedua hari sama, pilih hari pembanding yang berbeda. ':'')+(cut<1e9?`Dibatasi sampai pukul ${hhmm(cut)} (jam terakhir data hari terbaru) agar sepadan.`:'Seluruh hari penuh. Hari terbaru mungkin belum penuh.');
    if(DWD[CMP.da]===DWD[CMP.db]&&CMP.da!==CMP.db) note+=' Ini hari yang sama di minggu berbeda.';
    const hrs=[...new Set(D.calls.map(r=>r[2]))]; const h0=Math.min(...hrs), h1=Math.max(...hrs); const hs=[]; for(let h=h0;h<=h1;h++) hs.push(h);
    const cnt=R=>hs.map(h=>R.filter(r=>r[2]===h).length);
    const hA=cnt(RA), hB=cnt(RB);
    chart={title:'Dial per jam',sub:'Jam WIB. Hari yang dipotong tidak punya data setelah jam batas.',cats:hs.map(h=>String(h).padStart(2,'0')),A:hA,B:hB,tip:i=>`${String(hs[i]).padStart(2,'0')}:00–${String(hs[i]).padStart(2,'0')}:59<br>${la}: ${fmtN(hA[i])}<br>${lb}: ${fmtN(hB[i])}`};
  }
  const mA=met(RA), mB=met(RB);
  const totalAgents=A.filter((_,i)=>agentOk(i)).length;
  $('meta').textContent=`SPV ${D.spv} · ${D.label} · Call Review ${isWeek?'week to week':'day to day'} · ${lb} vs ${la} · ${totalAgents} agent`;
  $('cNote').innerHTML=note;
  $('cT1').textContent=chart.title; $('cS1').textContent=chart.sub;

  const K=[['Total dial','dials',fmtN],['Unique number','u',fmtN],['Dial / agent aktif','perAgent',v=>fmtN(Math.round(v))],['Agent aktif','act',fmtN],['Tersambung','ans',fmtN],['% Tersambung','rate',fmtRate,1],['Call > 5 menit','g5',fmtN],['Total durasi bicara','talk',hm]];
  const dAbs=(k)=>{const d=mB[k]-mA[k]; const sg=d>=0?'+':'-'; return k==='talk'?sg+hm(Math.abs(d)):k==='perAgent'?sg+fmtN(Math.abs(Math.round(d))):sg+fmtN(Math.abs(d));};
  $('cKpis').innerHTML=K.map(([l,k,f,pt])=>`<div class="kpi"><span class="l">${l}</span><span class="v" style="font-size:24px">${f(mB[k])}</span><span class="n">${la}: ${f(mA[k])}<br>${pt?pchip(mB[k],mA[k]):dchip(mB[k],mA[k])}${pt?'':` <span class="dl flat">(${dAbs(k)})</span>`}</span></div>`).join('');
  const lg=`<span><i style="background:var(--serA)"></i>${la}</span><span><i style="background:var(--blue)"></i>${lb}</span>`;
  $('cLg1').innerHTML=lg; $('cLg2').innerHTML=lg;
  $('cDow').innerHTML=groupedBar(chart.cats,chart.A,chart.B,la,lb,chart.tip);

  const grp=(R,key)=>{const m={}; R.forEach(r=>{const k=key(r); (m[k]=m[k]||[]).push(r);}); return m;};
  const gA=grp(RA,r=>A[r[0]].c), gB=grp(RB,r=>A[r[0]].c);
  const cl=coaches.filter(c=>A.some((a,i)=>a.c===c&&agentOk(i)));
  const cm=cl.map(c=>({c,a:met(gA[c]||[]),b:met(gB[c]||[])}));
  $('cCoachBar').innerHTML=groupedBar(cl.map(c=>c.split(' ')[0]),cm.map(x=>x.a.dials),cm.map(x=>x.b.dials),la,lb,i=>`${cl[i]}<br>${la}: ${fmtN(cm[i].a.dials)}<br>${lb}: ${fmtN(cm[i].b.dials)}`);
  const hd=`<thead><tr><th>Coach</th><th>Agent aktif</th><th>Dial</th><th>Unique</th><th>Dial / agent aktif</th><th>Tersambung</th><th>% Tersambung</th><th>&gt; 5 mnt</th><th>Total bicara</th></tr></thead>`;
  const crow=(name,sub,x,cls)=>`<tr class="${cls||''}"><td>${esc(name)}${sub?`<span class="sm">${sub}</span>`:''}</td>${cell(x.b.act,x.a.act,fmtN)}${cell(x.b.dials,x.a.dials,fmtN)}${cell(x.b.u,x.a.u,fmtN)}${cell(x.b.perAgent,x.a.perAgent,v=>fmtN(Math.round(v)))}${cell(x.b.ans,x.a.ans,fmtN)}${cell(x.b.rate,x.a.rate,fmtRate,1)}${cell(x.b.g5,x.a.g5,fmtN)}${cell(x.b.talk,x.a.talk,hm)}</tr>`;
  $('cCoach').innerHTML=hd+'<tbody>'+cm.map(x=>crow(x.c,A.find(a=>a.c===x.c).l,x)).join('')+crow('Total tim','',{a:mA,b:mB},'tot')+'</tbody>';

  const aA=grp(RA,r=>r[0]), aB=grp(RB,r=>r[0]);
  let al=A.map((a,i)=>({i,a,ma:met(aA[i]||[]),mb:met(aB[i]||[])})).filter(x=>agentOk(x.i)&&(x.ma.dials||x.mb.dials));
  const sk={dialAsc:(p,q)=>(p.mb.dials-p.ma.dials)-(q.mb.dials-q.ma.dials),dialDesc:(p,q)=>(q.mb.dials-q.ma.dials)-(p.mb.dials-p.ma.dials),uAsc:(p,q)=>(p.mb.u-p.ma.u)-(q.mb.u-q.ma.u),uDesc:(p,q)=>(q.mb.u-q.ma.u)-(p.mb.u-p.ma.u),name:(p,q)=>p.a.n.localeCompare(q.a.n)};
  al.sort(sk[CMP.sort]);
  $('cAgent').innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Agent</th><th>Dial</th><th>Unique</th><th>Tersambung</th><th>% Tersambung</th><th>&gt; 5 mnt</th><th>Total bicara</th></tr></thead><tbody>`+
    al.map(x=>`<tr><td>${esc(x.a.n)}<span class="sm">${esc(x.a.c)} · ${x.a.l}</span></td>${cell(x.mb.dials,x.ma.dials,fmtN)}${cell(x.mb.u,x.ma.u,fmtN)}${cell(x.mb.ans,x.ma.ans,fmtN)}${cell(x.mb.rate,x.ma.rate,fmtRate,1)}${cell(x.mb.g5,x.ma.g5,fmtN)}${cell(x.mb.talk,x.ma.talk,hm)}</tr>`).join('')+'</tbody>';
}

// ---------- performance + productivity + performance comparison ----------
const P = D.perf;
const PWK = P.weeks, PDATES = P.tdates, PDW = PDATES.map(isoW), PWD = PDATES.map(s=>(dObj(s).getUTCDay()+6)%7);
const PS = {period:'m', level:'coach'};
const fmtRpS = v => { const a=Math.abs(v); return a>=1e9?(v/1e9).toFixed(2).replace('.',',')+' M':a>=1e6?(v/1e6).toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+' jt':a>=1e3?Math.round(v/1e3)+' rb':String(Math.round(v)); };
const fmtRp = n => 'Rp '+fmtN(Math.round(n));
const fmtPct = v => v==null?'–':(v*100).toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+'%';
const fmt2 = v => v==null?'–':v.toFixed(2).replace('.',',');
const fmt1 = v => v==null?'–':(Number.isInteger(v)?String(v):v.toFixed(1).replace('.',','));
const elapsedW = w => { let n=0; for(let k=0;k<5;k++){ if(addDays(P.mon[w],k)<=P.lastTx) n++; } return n; };
// kategori per agent berdasarkan transaksi per minggu: Low < 1, Medium 1-7, High >= 8
const pcat = (eqAvg,eff) => eqAvg<1?'l':eqAvg<8?'m':'h';
const CATN = {h:'High',m:'Medium',l:'Low',n:'N/A'};
const catPill = c => `<span class="cat ${c}">${CATN[c]}</span>`;
const PA = {};
PWK.forEach(w=>{ PA[w]=A.map((_,i)=>{ const [wd,tg]=P.tg[w][i]; const eff=Math.min(wd,elapsedW(w)); return {wd,tg,eff,tgd:wd?tg*eff/wd:0,rev:0,txn:0,eq:0}; }); });
P.tx.forEach(([a,di,amt])=>{ const w=PDW[di]; if(!PA[w]) return; const o=PA[w][a]; o.txn++; o.rev+=amt; });
PWK.forEach(w=>PA[w].forEach(o=>{ o.eq = o.eff>0 ? (o.eff<o.wd ? o.txn*o.wd/o.eff : o.txn) : 0; o.proj = o.eff>0 && o.eff<o.wd; }));
const WDATA = PWK.filter(w=>elapsedW(w)>0);
const wShort = w => 'W'+w+' · '+dShort(P.mon[w])+' – '+dShort(addDays(P.mon[w],6));
function weeksSel(){ return PS.period==='m' ? WDATA : [+PS.period]; }
function fullSel(){ return PS.period==='m' ? PWK : [+PS.period]; }
function pAgg(ids,ws,fs){
  const o={n:0,rev:0,txn:0,tgd:0,tgf:0,eff:0,eq:0,nw:0};
  ids.forEach(i=>{ let e=0,nw=0; ws.forEach(w=>{const x=PA[w][i]; o.rev+=x.rev; o.txn+=x.txn; o.tgd+=x.tgd; e+=x.eff; if(x.eff>0){ nw++; o.eq+=x.eq; }}); o.eff+=e; o.nw+=nw; if(e>0) o.n++; (fs||ws).forEach(w=>{o.tgf+=PA[w][i].tg;}); });
  o.prod=o.eff?o.txn/o.eff:null; o.ach=o.tgd?o.rev/o.tgd:null; o.arpu=o.txn?o.rev/o.txn:null;
  o.wk=o.nw?o.eq/o.nw:null;               // rata-rata transaksi per agent per minggu
  o.cat=pcat(o.wk??0,o.eff);
  return o;
}
const pIds = () => A.map((_,i)=>i).filter(agentOk);
function groupIds(ids,key){ const m=new Map(); ids.forEach(i=>{ const k=key(i); if(!m.has(k)) m.set(k,[]); m.get(k).push(i); }); return [...m.entries()]; }
const catCount = (ids,ws,fs)=>{ const c={h:0,m:0,l:0,n:0}; ids.forEach(i=>c[pAgg([i],ws,fs).cat]++); return c; };

(function(){
  const opts=`<option value="m">Kumulatif Oktober · ${WDATA.length} minggu data</option>`+PWK.map(w=>`<option value="${w}"${elapsedW(w)?'':' disabled'}>${wShort(w)}${elapsedW(w)?'':' (belum ada data)'}</option>`).join('');
  ['pfP','prP'].forEach(id=>{ $(id).innerHTML=opts; $(id).addEventListener('change',e=>{ PS.period=e.target.value; $('pfP').value=PS.period; $('prP').value=PS.period; render(); }); });
  $('pfLv').addEventListener('click',e=>{ const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b) return; PS.level=b.dataset.lv; render(); });
})();

function lineChart(cats,series,tf,tipf){
  const W=560,H=230,L=60,R=14,T=14,Bt=26, iw=W-L-R, ih=H-T-Bt;
  const vals=series.flatMap(s=>s.vals.filter(v=>v!=null));
  const mx=niceMax(Math.max(1,...vals)), n=cats.length, step=n>1?iw/(n-1):iw;
  let s=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Grafik garis kumulatif">`;
  for(let t=0;t<=4;t++){ const v=mx/4*t, y=T+ih-ih*t/4; s+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="1"/><text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end">${tf(v)}</text>`; }
  const k=Math.ceil(n/9);
  cats.forEach((c,i)=>{ if(i%k===0||i===n-1) s+=`<text x="${L+step*i}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle">${esc(c)}</text>`; });
  series.forEach(se=>{
    let d='',st=false,last=null;
    se.vals.forEach((v,i)=>{ if(v==null) return; const x=L+step*i, y=T+ih-ih*v/mx; d+=(st?'L':'M')+x.toFixed(1)+' '+y.toFixed(1); st=true; last=[x,y]; });
    if(d) s+=`<path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="${se.color}" stroke-width="2"${se.dash?' stroke-dasharray="5 4"':''} stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    if(last&&!se.dash) s+=`<circle cx="${last[0]}" cy="${last[1]}" r="3.5" fill="${se.color}" stroke="var(--surface)" stroke-width="2"/>`;
  });
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++) s+=`<rect x="${L+step*i-step/2}" y="${T}" width="${step}" height="${ih}" fill="transparent" data-tip="${esc(tipf(i))}"/>`;
  return s+'</svg>';
}

function renderPerf(){
  const ids=pIds(), ws=weeksSel(), fs=fullSel();
  const tot=pAgg(ids,ws,fs);
  $('pfP').value=PS.period;
  $('pfLv').querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.lv===PS.level));
  $('meta').textContent=`SPV ${D.spv} · ${D.label} · Performance · ${PS.period==='m'?'Kumulatif Oktober (W'+WDATA.join(', W')+')':wShort(+PS.period)} · ${ids.length} agent`;
  $('pfNote').innerHTML=`Revenue = kolom <b>Amount</b> (kolom N) dari Raw transaksi. <b>TXN</b> = jumlah invoice. Agent dibaca dari kolom <b>agent name</b>. Target dari sheet Target &amp; Struktur. Data transaksi sampai <b>${dLab(P.lastTx)}</b>${P.outside?`, ${P.outside} invoice SPV Deti dari agent di luar daftar tim tidak dihitung`:''}. Kategori agent: Low &lt; 1, Medium 1 sampai 7, High ≥ 8 transaksi per minggu.`;
  const cc=catCount(ids,ws,fs);
  $('pfK').innerHTML=[
    ['Revenue',fmtRpS(tot.rev),`Achievement ${fmtPct(tot.ach)} dari target ${fmtRpS(tot.tgd)} s.d. data`],
    [PS.period==='m'?'Target bulan Oktober':'Target minggu',fmtRpS(tot.tgf),`Progress ${tot.tgf?fmtPct(tot.rev/tot.tgf):'–'} dari target penuh`],
    ['Transaksi (TXN)',fmtN(tot.txn),`${fmt1(tot.wk==null?null:Math.round(tot.wk*10)/10)} TXN per agent per minggu`],
    ['ARPU',tot.arpu?fmtRpS(tot.arpu):'–','revenue per transaksi'],
    ['Productivity',fmt2(tot.prod),'TXN per agent per hari kerja'],
    ['Agent per kategori',`${cc.h} · ${cc.m} · ${cc.l}`,`High · Medium · Low${cc.n?` · ${cc.n} N/A`:''}`]
  ].map(([l,v,n])=>`<div class="kpi"><span class="l">${l}</span><span class="v" style="font-size:24px">${v}</span><span class="n">${n}</span></div>`).join('');

  const wk=PWK.map(w=>pAgg(ids,[w],[w]));
  $('pfLg1').innerHTML=`<span><i style="background:var(--serA)"></i>Target</span><span><i style="background:var(--blue)"></i>Revenue</span>`;
  $('pfCh1').innerHTML=groupedBar(PWK.map(w=>'W'+w),wk.map(x=>x.tgf),wk.map((x,j)=>elapsedW(PWK[j])?x.rev:null),'Target','Revenue',i=>`${wShort(PWK[i])}<br>Target ${fmtRp(wk[i].tgf)}<br>Revenue ${elapsedW(PWK[i])?fmtRp(wk[i].rev):'belum ada data'}${elapsedW(PWK[i])&&wk[i].tgd?'<br>Achv '+fmtPct(wk[i].rev/wk[i].tgd):''}`,{v:fmtRpS,t:fmtRpS});

  const monthTarget=pAgg(ids,[],PWK).tgf, nDays=PWK.length*7, dayLab=[], pace=[], act=[]; let cum=0;
  const revByDay=PDATES.map(()=>0); P.tx.forEach(([a,di,amt])=>{ if(agentOk(a)) revByDay[di]+=amt; });
  for(let i=0;i<nDays;i++){ const d=addDays(P.mon[PWK[0]],i); dayLab.push(dShort(d)); pace.push(monthTarget*(i+1)/nDays); if(i<PDATES.length){ cum+=revByDay[i]; act.push(cum); } else act.push(null); }
  $('pfLg2').innerHTML=`<span><i style="background:var(--blue)"></i>Revenue kumulatif</span><span><i style="background:var(--serA)"></i>Pace target (merata per hari)</span>`;
  $('pfCh2').innerHTML=lineChart(dayLab,[{vals:pace,color:'var(--serA)',dash:1},{vals:act,color:BL}],fmtRpS,i=>`${dayLab[i]}<br>Pace target ${fmtRp(pace[i])}<br>Revenue kumulatif ${act[i]==null?'belum ada data':fmtRp(act[i])}`);

  const lv=PS.level; let groups;
  if(lv==='spv') groups=[[D.spv,ids]]; else if(lv==='layer') groups=groupIds(ids,i=>A[i].l); else if(lv==='coach') groups=groupIds(ids,i=>A[i].c); else groups=ids.map(i=>[A[i].n,[i]]);
  const lvName={spv:'Supervisor',layer:'Layer',coach:'Coach',agent:'Agent'}[lv];
  $('pfTT').textContent='Pencapaian per '+lvName.toLowerCase();
  const wcols=PS.period==='m'?WDATA:[];
  const head=`<thead><tr><th>${lvName}</th><th>Agent</th><th>Target</th><th>Revenue</th><th>Achievement</th><th>TXN</th><th>TXN / agent / minggu</th><th>ARPU</th><th>Workdays</th><th>Productivity</th><th>${lv==='agent'?'Kategori':'High · Medium · Low'}</th>${wcols.map(w=>`<th>Rev W${w}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead>`;
  const row=(name,sub,g,gi,cls)=>{ const c=catCount(gi,ws,fs); return `<tr class="${cls||''}"><td>${esc(name)}${sub?`<span class="sm">${esc(sub)}</span>`:''}</td><td class="num">${g.n}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(Math.round(g.tgd))}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(g.rev)}</td><td class="num"><div class="bar"><span class="t" style="background:var(--line)"><b style="width:${Math.min(1,g.ach||0)*90}px;background:var(--blue)"></b></span>${fmtPct(g.ach)}</div></td><td class="num">${g.txn}</td><td class="num">${fmt1(g.wk==null?null:Math.round(g.wk*10)/10)}</td><td class="num">${g.arpu?fmtN(Math.round(g.arpu)):'–'}</td><td class="num">${g.eff}</td><td class="num">${fmt2(g.prod)}</td><td>${lv==='agent'?catPill(g.cat):`<span class="num">${c.h} · ${c.m} · ${c.l}${c.n?' · '+c.n+' N/A':''}</span>`}</td>${wcols.map(w=>`<td class="num">${fmtN(pAgg(gi,[w],[w]).rev)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`; };
  const subOf=(gi)=> lv==='coach'?A[gi[0]].l : lv==='agent'?`${A[gi[0]].c} · ${A[gi[0]].l} · ${P.ten[gi[0]]}` : lv==='layer'?`${gi.length} agent` : 'Total SPV';
  let body=groups.map(([name,gi])=>row(name,subOf(gi),pAgg(gi,ws,fs),gi)).join('');
  if(lv!=='spv') body+=row('Total '+D.spv,'',tot,ids,'tot');
  $('pfT').innerHTML=head+'<tbody>'+body+'</tbody>';

  let cumR=0,cumT=0;
  $('pfW').innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>ISO Week</th><th>Target</th><th>Revenue</th><th>Achv</th><th>TXN</th><th>TXN / agent / mgg</th><th>Prod</th><th>Kumulatif revenue</th><th>Kumulatif achv</th></tr></thead><tbody>`+PWK.map((w,j)=>{
    const g=wk[j], has=elapsedW(w)>0; if(has){cumR+=g.rev; cumT+=g.tgd;}
    return has?`<tr><td>${wShort(w)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(g.tgf)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(g.rev)}</td><td class="num">${fmtPct(g.ach)}</td><td class="num">${g.txn}</td><td class="num">${fmt1(g.wk==null?null:Math.round(g.wk*10)/10)}</td><td class="num">${fmt2(g.prod)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(cumR)}</td><td class="num">${fmtPct(cumT?cumR/cumT:null)}</td></tr>`
    :`<tr><td>${wShort(w)}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(g.tgf)}</td><td colspan="7" class="sm" style="text-align:left">belum ada data transaksi</td></tr>`;
  }).join('')+'</tbody>';

  const dTx=PDATES.map(()=>({txn:0,rev:0})); P.tx.forEach(([a,di,amt])=>{ if(!agentOk(a)) return; const o=dTx[di]; o.txn++; o.rev+=amt; });
  let cr=0,ct=0;
  $('pfD').innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Hari</th><th>Revenue</th><th>TXN</th><th>Kumulatif revenue</th><th>Kumulatif TXN</th></tr></thead><tbody>`+dTx.map((o,i)=>{ cr+=o.rev; ct+=o.txn; return `<tr><td>${dLab(PDATES[i])}<span class="sm">W${PDW[i]}</span></td><td class="num">${fmtN(o.rev)}</td><td class="num">${o.txn}</td><td class="num">${fmtN(cr)}</td><td class="num">${ct}</td></tr>`; }).join('')+'</tbody>';
}

function renderProd(){
  const ids=pIds(), ws=weeksSel(), fs=fullSel();
  $('prP').value=PS.period;
  $('meta').textContent=`SPV ${D.spv} · ${D.label} · Productivity · ${PS.period==='m'?'Kumulatif Oktober (W'+WDATA.join(', W')+')':wShort(+PS.period)} · ${ids.length} agent`;
  const per=ids.map(i=>({i,g:pAgg([i],ws,fs)}));
  const cnt={h:0,m:0,l:0,n:0}; per.forEach(x=>cnt[x.g.cat]++);
  const tot=pAgg(ids,ws,fs);
  $('prK').innerHTML=[
    ['TXN per agent per minggu',fmt1(tot.wk==null?null:Math.round(tot.wk*10)/10),`rata-rata · ${fmt2(tot.prod)} TXN per hari kerja`],
    ['High',String(cnt.h),'8 transaksi per minggu atau lebih'],
    ['Medium',String(cnt.m),'1 sampai 7 transaksi per minggu'],
    ['Low',String(cnt.l),'kurang dari 1 transaksi per minggu (termasuk 0)'],
  ].map(([l,v,n])=>`<div class="kpi"><span class="l">${l}</span><span class="v" style="font-size:24px">${v}</span><span class="n">${n}</span></div>`).join('');
  const rows=[['Total '+D.spv,'',ids]];
  groupIds(ids,i=>A[i].l).forEach(([k,gi])=>rows.push([k,'Layer',gi]));
  groupIds(ids,i=>A[i].c).forEach(([k,gi])=>rows.push([k,A[gi[0]].l,gi]));
  $('prD').innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Kelompok</th><th>Agent</th><th>TXN / agent / minggu</th><th>High</th><th>Medium</th><th>Low</th><th>Komposisi</th></tr></thead><tbody>`+rows.map(([name,sub,gi],r)=>{
    const g=pAgg(gi,ws,fs), c=catCount(gi,ws,fs), base=c.h+c.m+c.l||1;
    return `<tr class="${r===0?'tot':''}"><td>${esc(name)}${sub?`<span class="sm">${esc(sub)}</span>`:''}</td><td class="num">${gi.length}</td><td class="num">${fmt1(g.wk==null?null:Math.round(g.wk*10)/10)}</td><td class="num">${c.h}</td><td class="num">${c.m}</td><td class="num">${c.l}</td><td><div class="seg"><b class="h" style="width:${c.h/base*100}%"></b><b class="m" style="width:${c.m/base*100}%"></b><b class="l" style="width:${c.l/base*100}%"></b></div></td></tr>`;
  }).join('')+'</tbody>';
  const cols=[...WDATA.map(w=>({lab:'W'+w,ws:[w]})),...(WDATA.length>1?[{lab:'Okt (kum.)',ws:WDATA}]:[])];
  const cs=cols.map(c=>({...c,k:catCount(ids,c.ws,c.ws),t:pAgg(ids,c.ws,c.ws)}));
  $('prW').innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Kategori</th>${cs.map(c=>`<th>${c.lab}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>`+
    ['h','m','l'].map(k=>`<tr><td>${catPill(k)}</td>${cs.map(c=>`<td class="num">${c.k[k]}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')+
    `<tr class="tot"><td>TXN / agent / minggu</td>${cs.map(c=>`<td class="num">${fmt1(c.t.wk==null?null:Math.round(c.t.wk*10)/10)}</td>`).join('')}</tr><tr><td>Productivity (TXN / hari)</td>${cs.map(c=>`<td class="num">${fmt2(c.t.prod)}</td>`).join('')}</tr><tr><td>Total TXN</td>${cs.map(c=>`<td class="num">${c.t.txn}</td>`).join('')}</tr><tr><td>Workdays</td>${cs.map(c=>`<td class="num">${c.t.eff}</td>`).join('')}</tr></tbody>`;
  per.sort((a,b)=>(b.g.wk??-1)-(a.g.wk??-1)||b.g.txn-a.g.txn);
  $('prA').innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Agent</th><th>TXN</th><th>Workdays</th><th>TXN / minggu</th><th>Productivity</th><th>Kategori</th>${WDATA.map(w=>`<th>TXN W${w}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>`+per.map(x=>{
    const wc=WDATA.map(w=>{ const o=PA[w][x.i]; const c=pcat(o.eq,o.eff); return `<td class="num">${o.eff?`<span class="dot ${c}"></span>${fmt1(Math.round(o.eq*10)/10)}${o.proj?'*':''}`:'–'}</td>`; }).join('');
    return `<tr><td>${esc(A[x.i].n)}<span class="sm">${esc(A[x.i].c)} · ${A[x.i].l} · ${P.ten[x.i]}</span></td><td class="num">${x.g.txn}</td><td class="num">${x.g.eff}</td><td class="num">${fmt1(x.g.wk==null?null:Math.round(x.g.wk*10)/10)}</td><td class="num">${fmt2(x.g.prod)}</td><td>${catPill(x.g.cat)}</td>${wc}</tr>`;
  }).join('')+'</tbody>';
}

// ---------- performance comparison ----------
const PC = {type:'week',a:null,b:null,mode:'same',sort:'revAsc',da:null,db:null};
(function(){
  const nd=w=>PDATES.filter((_,i)=>PDW[i]===w).length;
  const full=WDATA.filter(w=>nd(w)>=5); const last=PDATES.length-1;
  PC.db=last; PC.da=PDATES.indexOf(addDays(PDATES[last],-1)); if(PC.da<0) PC.da=Math.max(0,last-1);
  if(WDATA.length>=2){
    PC.b=full.length?full[full.length-1]:WDATA[WDATA.length-1]; const ix=WDATA.indexOf(PC.b); PC.a=WDATA[ix>0?ix-1:ix+1];
    const wo=sel=>WDATA.map(w=>`<option value="${w}"${w===sel?' selected':''}>${wShort(w)}</option>`).join('');
    $('xB').innerHTML=wo(PC.b); $('xA').innerHTML=wo(PC.a);
    $('xChips').innerHTML=WDATA.slice(1).map((w,i)=>`<button type="button" class="chip" data-b="${w}" data-a="${WDATA[i]}">W${w} vs W${WDATA[i]}</button>`).join('');
    $('xB').addEventListener('change',e=>{PC.b=+e.target.value;renderPcmp();});
    $('xA').addEventListener('change',e=>{PC.a=+e.target.value;renderPcmp();});
    $('xM').addEventListener('change',e=>{PC.mode=e.target.value;renderPcmp();});
    $('xChips').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b)return; PC.b=+b.dataset.b; PC.a=+b.dataset.a; $('xB').value=PC.b; $('xA').value=PC.a; renderPcmp();});
  } else { PC.type='day'; $('xType').querySelector('[data-t=week]').hidden=true; }
  const dopts=sel=>PDATES.map((d,i)=>`<option value="${i}"${i===sel?' selected':''}>${dLab(d)}</option>`).reverse().join('');
  $('xdB').innerHTML=dopts(PC.db); $('xdA').innerHTML=dopts(PC.da);
  $('xdB').addEventListener('change',e=>{PC.db=+e.target.value;renderPcmp();});
  $('xdA').addEventListener('change',e=>{PC.da=+e.target.value;renderPcmp();});
  $('xdChips').addEventListener('click',e=>{
    const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b)return; const act=b.dataset.act;
    if(act==='latest'){ PC.db=last; PC.da=PDATES.indexOf(addDays(PDATES[last],-1)); if(PC.da<0)PC.da=Math.max(0,last-1); }
    else { const n=PDATES.indexOf(addDays(PDATES[PC.db],act==='yday'?-1:-7)); if(n<0) return; PC.da=n; }
    $('xdB').value=PC.db; $('xdA').value=PC.da; renderPcmp();
  });
  $('xS').addEventListener('change',e=>{PC.sort=e.target.value;renderPcmp();});
  $('xType').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b)return; PC.type=b.dataset.t; renderPcmp();});
})();

function pm(rows){
  const act=new Set(rows.map(r=>r[0])).size; let rev=0; rows.forEach(r=>{rev+=r[2];});
  return {rev,txn:rows.length,act,arpu:rows.length?rev/rows.length:0,txnAct:act?rows.length/act:0,revAct:act?rev/act:0};
}
function renderPcmp(){
  const isWeek=PC.type==='week';
  $('xType').querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.t===PC.type));
  $('xWk').hidden=!isWeek; $('xDy').hidden=isWeek; $('xRow2').hidden=!isWeek;
  const tx=P.tx.filter(r=>agentOk(r[0]));
  const ids=pIds();
  let RA,RB,la,lb,note,wA=null,wB=null,fullBasis=false;
  if(isWeek){
    wA=PC.a; wB=PC.b; la='W'+wA; lb='W'+wB;
    const dIdx=w=>PDATES.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>PDW[i]===w);
    const wdOf=w=>new Set(dIdx(w).map(i=>PWD[i]));
    let common=null;
    if(PC.mode==='same'){ const sb=wdOf(wB); common=new Set([...wdOf(wA)].filter(x=>sb.has(x))); if(!common.size) common=null; }
    fullBasis=!common||(dIdx(wA).every(i=>common.has(PWD[i]))&&dIdx(wB).every(i=>common.has(PWD[i])));
    const pick=w=>tx.filter(r=>PDW[r[1]]===w&&(!common||common.has(PWD[r[1]])));
    RA=pick(wA); RB=pick(wB);
    note=`<b>${wShort(wB)}</b> dibanding <b>${wShort(wA)}</b>. `+(wA===wB?'Kedua minggu sama, pilih minggu pembanding yang berbeda. ':'')+(common?`Basis hari yang sama: ${[...common].sort().map(i=>WDN[i]).join(', ')}.`:`Basis total minggu: ${dIdx(wB).length} hari data vs ${dIdx(wA).length} hari data.${dIdx(wA).length!==dIdx(wB).length?' Jumlah hari berbeda, pilih basis "Hari yang sama" agar adil.':''}`);
  } else {
    la=dName2(PC.da); lb=dName2(PC.db);
    RA=tx.filter(r=>r[1]===PC.da); RB=tx.filter(r=>r[1]===PC.db);
    note=`<b>${dLab(PDATES[PC.db])}</b> dibanding <b>${dLab(PDATES[PC.da])}</b>.`+(PWD[PC.da]===PWD[PC.db]&&PC.da!==PC.db?' Ini hari yang sama di minggu berbeda.':'')+' Data transaksi hanya punya tanggal, tanpa jam.';
  }
  const mA=pm(RA), mB=pm(RB);
  $('meta').textContent=`SPV ${D.spv} · ${D.label} · Performance Review ${isWeek?'week to week':'day to day'} · ${lb} vs ${la} · ${ids.length} agent`;
  $('xNote').innerHTML=note;
  // achievement & productivity only for whole-week basis
  let extra=[];
  if(isWeek){
    const gA=pAgg(ids,[wA],[wA]), gB=pAgg(ids,[wB],[wB]);
    extra=[['Achievement',fullBasis?gB.ach:null,fullBasis?gA.ach:null,fmtPct,1],['Productivity (TXN/hari)',fullBasis?gB.prod:null,fullBasis?gA.prod:null,fmt2,0]];
  }
  const K=[['Revenue',mB.rev,mA.rev,fmtRpS,0],['Transaksi (TXN)',mB.txn,mA.txn,fmtN,0],['ARPU',mB.arpu,mA.arpu,v=>v?fmtRpS(v):'–',0],['Agent bertransaksi',mB.act,mA.act,fmtN,0],['TXN / agent bertransaksi',mB.txnAct,mA.txnAct,fmt2,0],['Revenue / agent bertransaksi',mB.revAct,mA.revAct,fmtRpS,0],...extra];
  $('xKpis').innerHTML=K.map(([l,b,a,f,pt])=>{ const ok=b!=null&&a!=null; return `<div class="kpi"><span class="l">${l}</span><span class="v" style="font-size:24px">${b==null?'–':f(b)}</span><span class="n">${la}: ${a==null?'–':f(a)}<br>${ok?(pt?pchip(b,a):dchip(b,a)):'<span class="dl flat">hanya pada basis total minggu</span>'}</span></div>`; }).join('');
  const lg=`<span><i style="background:var(--serA)"></i>${la}</span><span><i style="background:var(--blue)"></i>${lb}</span>`;
  ['xLg1','xLg2','xLg3','xLg4'].forEach(id=>$(id).innerHTML=lg);
  const grp=(R,key)=>{const m={}; R.forEach(r=>{const k=key(r); (m[k]=m[k]||[]).push(r);}); return m;};
  const gA=grp(RA,r=>A[r[0]].c), gB=grp(RB,r=>A[r[0]].c);
  const cl=coaches.filter(c=>A.some((a,i)=>a.c===c&&agentOk(i)));
  const cm=cl.map(c=>({c,a:pm(gA[c]||[]),b:pm(gB[c]||[])}));
  const short=cl.map(c=>c.split(' ')[0]);
  $('xCh1').innerHTML=groupedBar(short,cm.map(x=>x.a.rev),cm.map(x=>x.b.rev),la,lb,i=>`${cl[i]}<br>${la}: ${fmtRp(cm[i].a.rev)}<br>${lb}: ${fmtRp(cm[i].b.rev)}`,{v:fmtRpS,t:fmtRpS});
  $('xCh2').innerHTML=groupedBar(short,cm.map(x=>x.a.txn),cm.map(x=>x.b.txn),la,lb,i=>`${cl[i]}<br>${la}: ${cm[i].a.txn} TXN<br>${lb}: ${cm[i].b.txn} TXN`);
  if(isWeek){
    const arr=(w,k)=>{ const a=Array(7).fill(null); PDATES.forEach((_,i)=>{ if(PDW[i]===w) a[PWD[i]]=0; }); tx.forEach(r=>{ if(PDW[r[1]]===w) a[PWD[r[1]]]+=(k==='rev'?r[2]:1); }); return a; };
    const rA=arr(wA,'rev'), rB=arr(wB,'rev'), tA=arr(wA,'txn'), tB=arr(wB,'txn');
    $('xCh3').innerHTML=groupedBar(WDN,rA,rB,la,lb,i=>`${WDN[i]}<br>${la}: ${rA[i]==null?'tidak ada data':fmtRp(rA[i])}<br>${lb}: ${rB[i]==null?'tidak ada data':fmtRp(rB[i])}`,{v:fmtRpS,t:fmtRpS});
    $('xCh4').innerHTML=groupedBar(WDN,tA,tB,la,lb,i=>`${WDN[i]}<br>${la}: ${tA[i]==null?'tidak ada data':tA[i]+' TXN'}<br>${lb}: ${tB[i]==null?'tidak ada data':tB[i]+' TXN'}`);
  }
  const hd=`<thead><tr><th>Coach</th><th>Agent bertransaksi</th><th>Revenue</th><th>TXN</th><th>ARPU</th><th>TXN / agent</th></tr></thead>`;
  const crow=(name,sub,x,cls)=>`<tr class="${cls||''}"><td>${esc(name)}${sub?`<span class="sm">${sub}</span>`:''}</td>${cell(x.b.act,x.a.act,fmtN)}${cell(x.b.rev,x.a.rev,fmtRpS)}${cell(x.b.txn,x.a.txn,fmtN)}${cell(x.b.arpu,x.a.arpu,v=>v?fmtRpS(v):'–')}${cell(x.b.txnAct,x.a.txnAct,fmt2)}</tr>`;
  $('xCoach').innerHTML=hd+'<tbody>'+cm.map(x=>crow(x.c,A.find(a=>a.c===x.c).l,x)).join('')+crow('Total tim','',{a:mA,b:mB},'tot')+'</tbody>';
  const aA=grp(RA,r=>r[0]), aB=grp(RB,r=>r[0]);
  const catA=isWeek?(i=>pAgg([i],[wA],[wA]).cat):null, catB=isWeek?(i=>pAgg([i],[wB],[wB]).cat):null;
  let al=ids.map(i=>({i,a:pm(aA[i]||[]),b:pm(aB[i]||[])})).filter(x=>x.a.txn||x.b.txn);
  const sk={revAsc:(p,q)=>(p.b.rev-p.a.rev)-(q.b.rev-q.a.rev),revDesc:(p,q)=>(q.b.rev-q.a.rev)-(p.b.rev-p.a.rev),txnAsc:(p,q)=>(p.b.txn-p.a.txn)-(q.b.txn-q.a.txn),txnDesc:(p,q)=>(q.b.txn-q.a.txn)-(p.b.txn-p.a.txn),name:(p,q)=>A[p.i].n.localeCompare(A[q.i].n)};
  al.sort(sk[PC.sort]);
  $('xAgent').innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Agent</th><th>Revenue</th><th>TXN</th><th>ARPU</th>${isWeek?`<th>Kategori ${la} → ${lb}</th>`:''}</tr></thead><tbody>`+al.map(x=>`<tr><td>${esc(A[x.i].n)}<span class="sm">${esc(A[x.i].c)} · ${A[x.i].l}</span></td>${cell(x.b.rev,x.a.rev,fmtRpS)}${cell(x.b.txn,x.a.txn,fmtN)}${cell(x.b.arpu,x.a.arpu,v=>v?fmtRpS(v):'–')}${isWeek?`<td>${catPill(catA(x.i))} → ${catPill(catB(x.i))}</td>`:''}</tr>`).join('')+'</tbody>';
}
const dName2 = i => { const d=dObj(PDATES[i]); return ['Min','Sen','Sel','Rab','Kam','Jum','Sab'][d.getUTCDay()]+' '+d.getUTCDate()+' '+MONN[d.getUTCMonth()]; };

render();
</script>

</html>
